name: Stormchaser
summary: Drive an armored chase truck into extreme weather, starting with procedurally generated tornadoes. Get close, launch probes, film the storm and get out before it lifts you.
description: Every chase is a push-your-luck bet: the closer you get to the storm, the more your data and footage pay, and the harder the storm pulls. Anchor down, deploy probes into the core, dodge the debris and bail before the truck leaves the ground.

No two storms behave the same. Tornadoes turn, speed up, split, wrap in rain and rope out across farmland, small towns, suburbs, cities and badlands, and they throw cows, cars and houses as they go. Spend your haul on upgrades that bolt visibly onto the truck, then hire chase crews who keep earning while you're away.
Tornadoes are just the start. Future updates bring more kinds of extreme weather to chase, each with its own dangers and rewards.

features.title: Push your luck
features.text: Closer pays more and is more dangerous. Hold the rings, hit the core with probes and bail at the last second.

features.title: No two storms alike
features.text: Procedural tornadoes that turn, split, wrap in rain and rope out, on maps generated fresh for every chase. More extreme weather is on the way.

features.title: Everything goes flying
features.text: Trees, cars, cows, barns and houses get picked up and thrown, and the debris can hit your truck.

features.title: The truck is the hero
features.text: Engine, armor, anchors, tires, probes and cameras: every upgrade shows on the truck, tier after tier.

features.title: Crews and radar
features.text: Hire chase crews and build stations that keep chasing storms and earning while the app is closed.

features.title: Short sessions
features.text: A chase lasts 90 to 180 seconds and plays one-handed in portrait.

data: Your progress is saved on your phone. There's no account; if Android backup is on, Android can restore the save on a new phone. Otherwise uninstalling the game or clearing its storage deletes it, and we can't restore it.
To change your ad privacy choices, open Setup ▸ Privacy options in the game. Usage statistics and crash reports can be turned off in Setup.
Bought something that didn't arrive? Use Restore purchases in the game's Store or Setup. Refunds go through Google Play.
